notes: - **The Live window holds still again while you name someone.** With a name box open, or the pointer over the transcript, the feed stays where it is while new lines keep arriving below. Showing the recording bar again (the tray's **Show recording bar**, a Stop request, the show / hide key) used to read the transcript over and jump it to the live end under your pointer; it no longer touches a feed that is held. See [The Live window](/docs/live-window/#the-window-holds-still).
